title: Sales Force
shortDescription: Modern e-commerce platform with real-time inventory management
fullDescription: A full-stack e-commerce solution built with Next.js and Node.js. Features include real-time inventory tracking, secure payment processing, admin dashboard, and responsive design. Implemented advanced caching strategies and optimized database queries for high performance.

title: Stac Business
shortDescription: Analytics dashboard for enterprise data visualization
fullDescription: Enterprise-grade analytics dashboard with advanced data visualization, real-time updates, and custom reporting features. Built for scalability and performance with a focus on user experience.

title: Mobile Fitness App
fullDescription: A comprehensive fitness tracking application with workout plans, nutrition tracking, and social features. Includes real-time synchronization across devices and integrates with popular fitness wearables.
